obligation: FCC CPNI rules
basis: A telecommunications carrier for local exchange and toll service and an interconnected VoIP provider, which 64.2003(o) treats as a carrier: copper local exchange and toll lines, 54,500 interconnected VoIP lines including 14,200 hosted voice seats, and the CLEC voice customers billed in SYS-18. No size threshold or small-carrier exemption. 64.2010(h) applies only to CMRS providers, and the company has no wireless service

obligation: CPNI rules for broadband usage data
citation: 47 U.S.C. 222(h)(1); Ohio Telecom Ass'n v. FCC (6th Cir. 2025-01-02); 90 FR 38406
basis: Broadband internet access is an information service after Ohio Telecom Ass'n v. FCC, so broadband usage and configuration data is not CPNI. The BSS holds one record per customer, and POL-04 protects the whole account record to the CPNI standard

obligation: 2023 amendments to the CPNI breach rule (64.2011)
basis: The amendments to 64.2011 are delayed until the FCC publishes an effective-date notice, and none has been published. Tracked for planning; the P08 matrix carries both versions

obligation: FCC network outage reporting (NORS) and DIRS
basis: Wireline provider (4.3(g)) and interconnected VoIP provider (4.3(h)), including hosted voice. Thresholds are outage-based, not size-based. PSAP notice under 4.9(h) applies because the company is a covered 911 service provider

obligation: CALEA system security and integrity
basis: Local exchange service as a common carrier for hire (47 U.S.C. 1001(8)(A)). The 2025-07-01 merger of the CLEC entity triggers the 90-day refiling duty in 1.20005(a)

obligation: FCC submarine cable landing license national-security rules
basis: No cable landing license, cable landing station or SLTE

obligation: CIRCIA (pending rule)
basis: No final rule has been published. Counsel reads the proposed communications-sector criteria as likely to cover the company once a rule is final; until then, reporting to CISA is voluntary

obligation: SEC public-company cybersecurity disclosure
basis: Privately held corporation backed by a private equity sponsor; not an Exchange Act registrant

obligation: 911 reliability (covered 911 service provider)
citation: 47 CFR 9.19-9.20, as amended by FCC 26-39 (91 FR 42794)
basis: Five central offices (CO-1, CO-3, CO-5, CO-6, CO-8) are the last service-provider facility before 7 PSAPs, so the company operates central offices that directly serve a PSAP (9.19(a)(4)(i)(B)). The legacy benchmarks for circuit diversity, backup power and monitoring apply; the annual certification is replaced by a one-time certification after a compliance-date notice

obligation: Caller ID authentication and robocall mitigation
basis: Voice service provider. The small voice service provider extension (64.6304(a)) expired on 2023-06-30, so the line count does not matter

obligation: Secure Networks Act reporting
basis: Provider of advanced communications service. The 2022 certification states that the network has no covered equipment, so no annual report is due unless covered equipment is obtained

obligation: Emergency Alert System rules
basis: No video or broadcast service

obligation: FTC Act Section 5 (broadband and other non-common-carrier services)
applies: Yes, for services other than common carrier services
basis: Section 5 excludes common carriers subject to the Communications Act (15 U.S.C. 45(a)(2)); counsel reads the exclusion as limited to the company's common carrier services, so broadband data practices and offer statements fall under Section 5

obligation: FAR 52.204-25 and 52.204-23 reporting
basis: No federal prime contracts or subcontracts; government customers are state and local

obligation: Florida Information Protection Act (breach notification)
basis: The company holds personal information of Florida residents (about 205,000 accounts)

obligation: Breach notification laws of other states
basis: About 8% of residential accounts belong to seasonal residents with an address in another state, so the law of each state where affected individuals reside applies

obligation: Florida Security of Communications Act (recording consent)
basis: Care calls are recorded and, for 60 agents, transcribed by agent assist in Florida, so all-party consent applies; the recording notice is the consent mechanism

obligation: OFAC sanctions risk for ransomware payments
basis: Applies to all U.S. persons before any ransom payment

obligation: Customer contracts: SLAs and CPNI terms
citation: Business data, Business Services and enterprise contracts
basis: 99.99% availability SLAs on protected business circuits and hosted voice; 320 enterprise and government contracts set CPNI authentication terms (47 CFR 64.2010(g))

obligation: Customer requests for a SOC 2 Type 2 report on Business Services
basis: A regional hospital system, two county governments, a school district and three credit unions ask for a SOC 2 Type 2 report covering Security and Availability, and some also Confidentiality

obligation: Cyber insurance policy terms
basis: Notice through the carrier hotline before incident vendors are engaged

obligation: Lender and sponsor notice terms
citation: Credit agreement and sponsor reporting terms
basis: The credit agreement and sponsor reporting terms require prompt notice of material events, such as a severity 1 incident or material outage

obligation: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard
citation: PCI DSS (card brand rules through the payment processor)
basis: Cards are taken through the payment processor's hosted pages and a tokenized IVR; PCI DSS duties are contractual and outside this sample
